title: The Panama Canal is inaugurated
summary: The Panama Canal was inaugurated on 15 August 1914 with the transit of the steamship Ancon. The waterway linked Atlantic and Pacific shipping routes.

claims.text: The Panama Canal was inaugurated on 15 August 1914 with the transit of the steamship Ancon. The waterway linked Atlantic and Pacific shipping routes.
Formal opening date, not the first movement of any vessel through any part of the works.
The ceremonial opening is distinct from earlier construction and test passages. A fuller account must include workers, local communities and the politics of control.
